Title: Bearly Escaping
Description: Breaking out of captivity, Bearly is trying to escape. Hunters surround, traps a plenty. It's time for her survival instincts to kick in.
Game Concept: Survival high score game - the longer you survive the more points you get

Ideas.Hunters: Enemy units who shoot, or throw nets, or set up traps
Ideas.Bullet: A bullet will not kill the bear but it will slow down for a set time
Ideas.Net: Projectile object that will catch you. Arrow Key Code for release.
Ideas.Trap: Stationary object that will catch you. Arrow Key Code for relase.
Ideas.Arrow Key Code: Code gets longer each time you get caught. Incorrect Input or when hit it 'resets' the code. (Random Sequence UP,DOWN,LEFT,RIGHT)
Ideas.Objects: Stationary Objects you can't move or destroy (eg. trees/houses)
Ideas.Score: Multipliers as you kill hunters or break traps - highest multiplier when in enrage mode but it drops down to 1x after
Ideas.Food: 0.3 second sit down to eat and reset speed to default, and add points
Ideas.Enrage: Obtain the enrage through either killing hunters/traps or alternatively getting hit or trapped by bullets/traps, each time you use it, it gets harder to get

Lofty Goal: Set up a High Score Leaderboard
